name: Three Islands Whale Shark Dive
summary: Three Islands Whale Shark Dive is a locally run Exmouth operator offering full-day whale shark and humpback whale swims on Ningaloo Reef. Tours run on 17-metre boats with a dedicated spotter plane, and a safety tender stays near swimmers in the water. Private charters are also available.
standouts: Advanced ECO Certification by Ecotourism Australia
EcoStar accreditation by Quality Tourism Australia
Dedicated spotter plane, flown by Ningaloo Aviation
A safety tender follows every snorkel and whale shark swim

trips.title: Whale Shark Tour Exmouth
trips.summary: A full-day whale shark swim on Ningaloo Reef on one of two 17-metre boats, Draw Card or Seafari. The day starts with a reef snorkel, then a dedicated spotter plane finds whale sharks for swimmers to join in groups of up to 10 with a guide and photographer. A safety tender stays close while you swim, and meals and photos are included.
highlights: Dedicated spotter plane and a safety tender beside swimmers
No-sighting guarantee: free repeat tour, a 2-year voucher or a $100 refund per person
Manta rays from late May and humpback whales from the boat from June

trips.requirements: No age limit. Snorkelling experience helps but is not required. Child fare is 16 and under, adult is 17 and over. Swimmers keep at least 3 metres from the whale shark's body and 4 metres from its tail, and must not touch it.
trips.checkNotes: priceFrom is the Observer Only fare ($250, no swim); the cheapest swimmer fare is the child snorkeller at $590 and the adult snorkeller is $660. Season conflicts on the page: the tour box says 'Early March - Late August' (matching the Rezdy slug 'mar-aug'), while the text says tours run early March to early October. Used the box. Time box says 7:45am to 4:30pm; itinerary says return to accommodation between 4 and 5pm, so durationMinutes left null. The No-Sighting Guarantee voucher is 'transferable' on the Tours page but 'non-transferable' in the Terms; observers are not covered.

trips.title: Humpback Whale Tour
trips.summary: A full day for strong swimmers aged 13 and over, focused on swimming with humpback whales off Ningaloo. A spotter plane finds the whales and the crew decides when it is safe and the whales are receptive before swimmers go in, in groups of 7. The day includes a reef snorkel, meals and a chance to swim with whale sharks or manta rays if spotted.
highlights: Chance to swim with whale sharks and manta rays if spotted
All photos from the onboard photographer included

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: A full-day private charter on a 17-metre boat for your group only, with transfers, a spotter plane and an onboard photographer. Depending on the season the group can swim with whale sharks or humpback whales, snorkel coral gardens and visit quiet beaches at its own pace. Children are welcome, with in-water help for less confident swimmers.

Snorkellers only, not observers: a free repeat tour on the next available day, a free repeat voucher valid 2 years, or a $100 refund per person.
